    BEFORE YOU START

    A few things
    you may want to know.

    Can I start if I work alone?＋

    Yes. Start with one specific task, such as organizing customer needs, drafting content or compiling reports. Build a small, reviewable workflow before deciding whether you need advisory support.

    Can I use AI without coding skills?＋

    Yes. Begin by defining the inputs, outputs and review process. Tools vary by task; integration or development needs are assessed separately.

    Do I need to buy many AI tools first?＋

    Review your existing tools and work needs first. Confirm the purpose, scope and budget before adding subscriptions, development or hardware.

    Can AI guarantee revenue or unicorn status?＋

    No. A one-person unicorn is our long-term aspiration. AI can support research, production and workflows, but growth depends on demand, product value, execution and business judgment.

    Does AI-generated work need human review?＋

    Yes. People remain responsible for facts, external commitments, customer data and important decisions. We discuss data access, review and exceptions before scaling a pilot.

    How do I start working with you?＋

    Complete the starter checklist or outline your needs on our Chinese services page. The site prepares an email draft for you to review and send. Scope, timing and fees depend on your needs.
